description.value: False Creek is an urban inlet cutting through the heart of Vancouver, best known to cyclists as the body of water encircled by Vancouver's world-famous seawall multi-use path. The waterway separates downtown Vancouver from the False Creek South and Olympic Village neighbourhoods, and the surrounding shoreline offers continuous, car-free cycling along parks, marinas, and public plazas. It is a central landmark on any cycling tour of Vancouver's waterfront.
